subject.title: fix(ui): show a simple channel settings view with a flip to advanced

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled Control UI presentation change be accepted once the remaining checks and normal source review confirm the shared renderer has no regression outside channel settings?
rationale: The protected label prevents automated cleanup or a merge verdict, and this review environment could not inspect the repository implementation or local proof artifacts.

options.title: Complete maintainer review
options.body: Review the shared renderer and channel preference flow after checks complete, then merge if the existing config-page behavior remains unchanged.

options.title: Request a narrower revision
options.body: Ask for a smaller channel-local implementation only if maintainer review finds the shared rendering abstraction causes an unwanted cross-page coupling.

recommendation.title: Complete maintainer review
recommendation.body: Review the shared renderer and channel preference flow after checks complete, then merge if the existing config-page behavior remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation and can supply the intended UI behavior and validation context while a feature-history owner is identified.
